parameters.content:
## Create a proposal recap video

### How it works
Take a deal from Google Sheets or a webhook and render a landscape recap of its scope, amount, timeline and call to action. Save the URL to the sheet or return it to your CRM.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect both Google Sheets nodes to the same spreadsheet and tab, or set source=webhook and POST dealName, company and amount.
4. Set senderName, senderCompany, meetingUrl and branding in Config. Amounts are formatted in the supplied currency, never converted.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/proposal-recap-video.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Choose the deal input

Sheet headers: DealName, Company, ContactFirstName, Amount, Currency, ScopeLine1, ScopeLine2, ScopeLine3, TimelineWeeks, ValidUntil, Status, VideoUrl. DealName, Company and Amount are required; leave Status empty.

## 3. Check for a pending deal

Render only when a usable deal is found. Empty queues finish without a render.

## 4. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 5. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits; upstream AI services may charge separately.

## 6. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

nodes.name: 7. Save or return the video URL

parameters.content:
## 7. Save or return the video URL

Update the matching sheet row when present. Webhook callers receive the result after rendering; allow a suitable request timeout.

## 8. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
